navigation.rail.traversal: Tab into the rail; move using Up/Down and Tab out. Check destination names, logical order and disabled skipping.
navigation.rail.stateAnnouncements: Select a different destination, then explore selected and disabled destinations. Record name, role and selected/unavailable announcements.
navigation.rail.activation: Activate an enabled destination with Enter/Space and try a disabled destination. Exactly the enabled destination changes selection.
navigation.rail.focus: Move focus away and return; verify the focused destination and visible focus ring agree; repeat RTL.

navigation.tabs.traversal: Tab into the tab strip; use Left/Right, Home/End where supported; check disabled skipping and tab panel reading order.
navigation.tabs.stateAnnouncements: Explore selected and unselected tabs plus a disabled tab; record role/name and selected/unavailable state.
navigation.tabs.activation: Activate another tab with keyboard; verify the corresponding panel is exposed and disabled tabs cannot activate.
navigation.tabs.focus: Navigate into the selected panel and back; verify focus remains predictable across tab changes and RTL.

navigation.menu.traversal: Open menu using keyboard; use Up/Down, inspect checkable and disabled rows; verify disabled rows cannot receive activation.
navigation.menu.stateAnnouncements: Explore normal, checked/unchecked and disabled entries. Record names, roles, checked and unavailable state.
navigation.menu.activation: Activate enabled entry, reopen and toggle checkable entry; disabled entry must not invoke its action.
navigation.menu.focus: Close with Escape and check focus returns to the invoking control; repeat keyboard activation.
navigation.menu.expressiveState: Enable expressive Menu styling; inspect checked, unchecked and disabled rows. Names and semantic states must remain equivalent to standard Menu.

navigation.breadcrumb.traversal: Tab through the visible path segments and overflow menu; narrow the view and inspect the hidden path entries.
navigation.breadcrumb.stateAnnouncements: Explore current and ancestor segments, overflow and editable location; verify distinguishable names and current-location context.
navigation.breadcrumb.activation: Open overflow using keys and activate an ancestor; use Ctrl+L and Enter to submit a location; verify intended path change.
navigation.breadcrumb.focus: Use Ctrl+L then Escape; verify focus restoration; activate a segment and check accessible focus in RTL.

navigation.command-palette.traversal: Open the palette from a focusable invoker, type a query and use Up/Down through the results; inspect groups and empty results.
navigation.command-palette.stateAnnouncements: Record accessible query name, result names, highlighted result and empty/no-result feedback.
navigation.command-palette.activation: Choose a command with Enter; exactly that command executes. Repeat with a query with no valid result.
navigation.command-palette.focus: Open the palette, verify query focus, dismiss using Escape and verify original focus returns.

layout.split-view.traversal: Tab to each splitter handle and its adjacent pane controls; repeat horizontal and vertical orientations.
layout.split-view.stateAnnouncements: Inspect accessible splitter name, divider role, orientation/value where exported and collapsed state/context.
layout.split-view.activation: Use physical arrow keys, Shift modifiers, Home/End and Enter collapse/restore as supported. Check constraints and the correct adjacent panes.
layout.split-view.focus: Keep focus on the divider while resizing/collapsing; verify visible and spoken focus; repeat RTL.

navigation.bar.traversal: Tab into bar and navigate with horizontal arrows; repeat RTL and verify disabled destination skipping.
navigation.bar.stateAnnouncements: Explore destination names including icon-only presentation; record selected and unavailable state.
navigation.bar.activation: Activate enabled destination by keyboard and verify selection; attempt disabled activation, which must not change selection.
navigation.bar.focus: Tab away and back; verify item-level accessible focus and visible indicator agree.

surface.side-sheet.focusContainment: Open modal sheet from a keyboard-focused invoker; cycle Tab and Shift+Tab. Focus stays in sheet while modal.
surface.side-sheet.titleAnnouncement: Record actual announcement on opening, including sheet title and meaningful dialog/panel context.
surface.side-sheet.dismissal: Press Escape; verify sheet and modal scrim disappear and host is available again.
surface.side-sheet.focusRestoration: Dismiss from an interior focusable child; check focus returns to the original invoker.

surface.tooltip.focusTrigger: Use Tab, not pointer hover, to focus the target. Wait for configured delay and verify tooltip appears.
surface.tooltip.announcement: Record the target name and tooltip text actually spoken by the native reader.
surface.tooltip.dismissal: Move focus away or dismiss using the supported keyboard action; tooltip disappears without a stale announcement.
surface.tooltip.focusPreservation: Check focus remains on the target while tooltip opens and closes; continue Tab traversal.

data.badge.numericAnnouncement: Set a numeric count and explore badge/owning context; record the notification count spoken.
data.badge.overflowAnnouncement: Set a count above the configured maximum; verify spoken overflow meaning is understandable, not misleading.
data.badge.dotAnnouncement: Switch to dot mode; verify new-content meaning is accessible without a fictitious number.
data.badge.dynamicUpdate: Change count/dot state while reader is active; record whether updated state is exposed or announced. Do not infer speech from Qt signals.

navigation.suite.traversal: Explore bar in Compact and rail in Medium; use horizontal then vertical arrows; check names and disabled skipping.
navigation.suite.stateAnnouncements: Record selected, focused and disabled destination states in both presentations.
navigation.suite.activation: Activate destinations in Compact and Medium with keys; verify selected index and intended page.
navigation.suite.focusAcrossModeSwitch: Focus a destination and resize across 600 px boundary in both directions; verify same logical selection and meaningful focus.

layout.adaptive-shell.responsiveComposition: Resize through Compact, Medium, Expanded, Large and ExtraLarge; explore navigation and main content in each.
layout.adaptive-shell.contentFocusPreservation: Focus a main content control; resize through breakpoints and confirm focus remains on the same control when visible.
layout.adaptive-shell.supportingPaneTransition: Resize across supporting-pane visibility threshold; verify hidden content leaves reader traversal and visible content reappears.
layout.adaptive-shell.rtlReadingOrder: Switch RTL and repeat Compact and Expanded; compare spoken reading order with logical navigation, main and supporting content.

button.split.primaryAction: Focus primary action, activate with Space/Enter, verify only primary action fires and record announcement.
button.split.secondaryAction: Focus trailing action, record its distinct name, activate it and verify only the secondary action fires.
button.split.focusOrder: Tab and Shift+Tab between both actions and neighbors; repeat RTL, verify distinct focus targets.
button.split.disabledState: Disable split button; inspect unavailable state and verify neither action fires.

button.group.traversal: Tab into group; use Left/Right and Home/End; inspect logical action names and skip disabled children.
button.group.checkedState: Select a different action in exclusive mode; record checked/unchecked transitions and group context.
button.group.activation: Activate using Space/Enter; verify the intended action and selection change exactly once.
button.group.rtlTraversal: Switch RTL; compare Left/Right focus movement with visual order and logical action identity.

navigation.floating-toolbar.traversal: Tab to named actions; use arrows and Home/End; check disabled actions and visible focus.
navigation.floating-toolbar.collapsedState: Collapse and expand toolbar; inspect visible actions and record whether hidden actions are excluded from reader traversal.
navigation.floating-toolbar.activation: Activate each available named action using keyboard; verify exactly the intended action fires; disabled actions do not fire.
navigation.floating-toolbar.orientation: Switch horizontal to vertical and RTL; verify arrow navigation, accessible names and focus order match the orientation.

progress.loading-indicator.busyAnnouncement: Start loading; explore indicator using native reader/object navigation and record actual busy/in-progress announcement.
progress.loading-indicator.idleAnnouncement: Stop loading; record actual idle/completed state; stale busy announcement must not remain.
progress.loading-indicator.reducedMotionState: Enable reduced motion; confirm static rendering without losing the current accessible loading state.
progress.loading-indicator.stateChange: Toggle active to idle and back while reader is active; record actual transition announcements or lack thereof.

data.segmented-list.traversal: Explore list and items with keyboard and reader navigation; verify named rows and disabled skipping.
data.segmented-list.selectionState: Change selection; record selected/unselected states and list context.
data.segmented-list.activation: Activate focused list item using Enter/Space; verify correct item and event, not merely a visual highlight.
data.segmented-list.segmentContext: Inspect first/middle/last and single-item groups after insert/remove; verify names, item order and meaningful list/selection context.

compact.chip.checkedState: Use expressive Filter Chip; toggle checked state and record checked/unchecked announcements.
compact.chip.activation: Activate using Space/Enter; verify exactly one intended action; repeat disabled.
compact.chip.removal: Use a removable expressive chip; focus and remove with Delete/Backspace or supported close action; verify correct chip disappears.
compact.chip.focus: Traverse eligible chips using Tab/Shift+Tab; after removal check focus remains meaningful and no stale removed item is exposed.
